title: Financial Mathematics 1 (TUM, Modul MA3407)
description: At the end of the module students are able to understand the fundamentals of mathematical finance and portfolio optimization in discrete time and will be able to evaluate financial derivatives in single- and multi-period financial markets. Moreover, students are able to implement different numerical methods and pricing formulas, They are familiar with the seminal work of Harry Markowitz on mean-variance theory, understand the theoretical background and practical impact of efficient portfolios and the capital asset pricing model. They also know the most important risk measures and are able to evaluate and manage portfolios according to their risk-return profiles. Case Studies and examples in the lecture or in the exercises give a further insight into the concepts of portfolio analysis used in the investment industry. 9 ECTS, angeboten im Wintersemester, Version 2021s, verantwortet von Zagst, Rudi.
